title: Network
hint: How the box connects to your network. A change is tried first: it only stays if you keep it within 2 minutes.
empty: The box reports no network interface.

entry.name: Network
entry.hint: The box’s address and its network settings.
entry.pending: A network change on {intf} is waiting to be kept: {time} left.

form.title: New settings for {intf}
form.mode: How the box gets its address
form.dnsHint: Up to 4 IPv4 addresses, separated by commas.
form.dhcpHint: The box asks your router for its address, gateway and DNS servers.
form.unchanged: These are the settings the box already uses.
form.busy: Keep or undo the change already waiting before making another one.
form.needsApprover: Changing the network takes a code from an approver phone. Add one first.

error.ipv4: Enter an IPv4 address with its prefix, like 192.168.1.20/24.
error.gateway: Enter an IPv4 address, like 192.168.1.1, or leave it empty.
error.dns_servers: Enter at most 4 IPv4 addresses, separated by commas.
error.search_domains: Enter at most 4 domain names, separated by commas.

warn.title: Apply the new settings?
warn.hint: The box switches to them now, and this page may lose it. Keep the new settings within 2 minutes, from the new address if it changed, or the box goes back to the previous ones by itself.

pending.title: Keep the new settings on {intf}?
pending.hint: The box is trying the new settings. If nobody keeps them in time, it goes back to the previous ones by itself.
pending.expired: Time is up. Unless someone kept the settings from the new address, the box is back on the previous ones.
pending.lost: The box no longer answers here. That is expected if its address changed.
pending.reopen: If this page stops answering, open it at the new address and keep the settings there:
pending.reopenNow: Open this page at the new address and keep the settings there:
pending.reopenDhcp: The box now takes its address from DHCP: find it in your router’s list of devices, open this page at that address and keep the settings there.
pending.moves: This page uses the box’s old address, and will stop answering. Open the new address and keep the settings there.
pending.onlyIfAnswers: Keep from here only if this page still answers.
pending.unanswered: The box did not answer here. If its address changed, keep the settings from the new address.
pending.ended: This change has already ended: kept, undone or rolled back.

done.confirmed: The new settings on {intf} are kept.
done.reverted: {intf} is back on its previous settings.
done.not_applied: The box kept its settings: the change to {intf} did not take effect.

alert.title: The network change on {intf} was rolled back
alert.hint: Nobody kept the new settings within 2 minutes, so the box went back to its previous ones. Nothing else was changed.
